description_en: Queries the logs of a Logstash instance
kebab_example: aliyun elasticsearch list-logstash-log --instance-id ls-cn-v0h1kzca0000 --type LOGSTASH_INSTANCE_LOG --query host:10.7.xx.xx_AND_level:info_AND_content:opening --begin-time 1531910852074 --end-time 1531910852074 --page 1 --size 20 --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListLogstashLog

parameters.description_en:
The log type. Valid values:

- LOGSTASH_INSTANCE_LOG: main log.
- SEARCHSLOW: searching slow log.
- INDEXINGSLOW: indexing slow log.
- JVMLOG: GC log.
- LOGSTASH_DEBUG_LOG: debug log.
parameters.description_zh:
